newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs mixed, natural gasoline demand seen.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs mixed, natural gasoline demand seen.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mixed in quiet trade on Monday, with demand for natural gasoline in the Midwest seen strong due to the spread with unleaded.
In Conway, Kansas, spot natural gasoline was up about a cent to between 44.50 cents and 45.00 cents a gallon amid a 17 cent spread to unleaded.
Conway isobutane was trading on par amid demand, traders said, by a Midwest refinery that is expected to come back up from turnaround later this week.
Spot propane in the Midwest and the U.S. Gulf Coast, however, was largely unchanged from last Friday in quiet activity.
Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot material traded at 35.50 cents, even with last week. Conway material was pegged 36.00/36.25 cents, a quarter cents below Friday.
Traders said they were expecting trade to be seasonally quiet ahead of the close of the month.
